# Gramlot 0.3.15

- Consume dataSetter nodes after their Data write without rebuilding removed Source nodes.
- Load optional page_data.tytx Data before defaults and rendering on the first main response.
- Select each page's declared collections and reuse prepared grammars without sharing mutable Source, Data or authorization.
- Add the Mela desktop/mobile theme and fix opaque floating-window surfaces.
- Reorganize the widget reference around component families and shared attributes.

This release retains the previously recorded audit debt and provisional component maturity. It does not include the independent Typst package split or experimental database work.
